---
title: "Dependency licenses"
author: "Michael Barkasi"
date: "October 13, 2026 (v1.0)"
---

This package uses code from the following packages, which are distributed under the licenses listed below.

* Updated October 13, 2026, by Claude Sonnet 5; checked by MB.
* Updated October 16, 2026, by Claude Sonnet 5, to add BH (new LinkingTo dependency), and to add
  parallel and mvtnorm, both already in use (parallel in R/main.R and R/dg_legacy.R; mvtnorm in
  tests/testthat/) but missing from this file until now; checked by MB
* Updated October 27, 2026, by Claude Sonnet 5: switched the NLopt dependency from the system
  library to the nloptr package (new LinkingTo/Imports dependency, entry added below); removed
  MASS, gridExtra, grid, and dplyr (declared dependencies that turned out not to be used anywhere
  in the current code); and reclassified Matrix as a test-only dependency (used only in
  tests/testthat/test-nearPD.R, like mvtnorm) rather than a runtime one.
